brief.title: Lichess Chess Game Analytics: Patterns of Victory, Openings, and Player Dynamics
brief.one_liner: A comprehensive analysis of over 20,000 Lichess chess games exploring win rates, opening strategies, rating dynamics, and game outcome patterns.
brief.goal: The reader should gain a thorough understanding of the key factors that influence game outcomes on Lichess, including the impact of color (white vs. black), rating differentials, opening choices, and time controls — enabling data-driven insights for chess enthusiasts, coaches, and platform analysts.

required_sections.title: Dataset Overview & Game Distribution
required_sections.objective: Summarize the dataset scope, including total games, proportion of rated vs. unrated games, distribution of game outcomes (mate, resign, outoftime, draw), and winner distribution (white, black, draw).

required_sections.title: White vs. Black: The First-Move Advantage
required_sections.objective: Analyze win rates by color across all games and by victory status. Quantify whether white holds a statistically meaningful advantage and how this varies by rating bracket and time control.

required_sections.title: Rating Dynamics and Their Impact on Outcomes
required_sections.objective: Examine the distribution of player ratings, the relationship between rating differentials and win probability, and how average game length (turns) varies across rating tiers.

required_sections.title: Opening Analysis: Popular Openings and Their Success Rates
required_sections.objective: Identify the most frequently played openings (by ECO code and name), their win rates for white and black, and the relationship between opening depth (opening_ply) and game outcomes.

required_sections.title: Time Control Patterns and Game Characteristics
required_sections.objective: Analyze how different time increments (increment_code) affect game length, victory status distribution, and the likelihood of timeout vs. checkmate vs. resignation.

required_sections.title: Key Findings and Strategic Takeaways
required_sections.objective: Synthesize the most important patterns discovered across all analyses into actionable insights for players and chess analysts.

kpis.name: White Win Rate
kpis.description: Percentage of games won by white out of all decisive games (excluding draws).

kpis.name: Average Game Length
kpis.description: Mean number of turns per game, segmented by victory status and rating tier.

kpis.name: Checkmate Rate
kpis.description: Percentage of games that end in checkmate (mate) versus resignation or timeout.

kpis.name: Rating Differential Impact
kpis.description: Correlation between the absolute rating difference (white_rating - black_rating) and the probability of the higher-rated player winning.

kpis.name: Top Opening Win Rate
kpis.description: Win rate of the top 10 most popular openings for both white and black.
